parameters: protocol/study_defaults.json (authoritative, YAML twin) -- development defaults, NOT frozen; master seeds and context list follow at the freeze

modules.streams.py: PCG64 from SeedSequence (study, context, split, role, episode[, extra]); roles 10..70; split IDs train 0 / val 1 / test 2 / context 9; Aeon seeds 900000-900104 rejected; no hash(), no global RNG
modules.contexts.py: per context: permutation of the 34 sorted IDs (first 8 = 4 write pairs, next 9 = read nodes, last = reference), omega N(0, 0.1^2) centred
modules.encoding.py: theta(0) = phi 1 + a E u once at t = 0 (a = 0.35); controls zero_impulse and reset
modules.observation.py: task A: 33 differences to the context reference (66 features); task B: 8 read nodes + reference, all unwritten (16 features); fixed order; structural check
modules.surrogates.py: uncoupled, uniform_total, strength_surrogate (four-node switches, 20000 proposals, own stream, invariant report incl. degenerate steps, Frobenius distance, weight quantiles, top eigenvalues); no claim of a uniform ensemble
modules.episodes.py: per (context, split): u, phi, eps from one stream per episode and role; per (context, split, condition, control) ONE RK4 trajectory (AE-01) read at the 7 grid times

acceptance.reference_leak_negative: B features at t = 0 identical for different u (unwritten reference); a written reference would differ (shown); uncoupled B features identical for different u at ALL 7 times
acceptance.reset_zero_impulse: identical states for different u at all times (same phi and eps), both controls
acceptance.surrogate_invariants: symmetric, zero diagonal, [0,1], node strengths <= 1e-12 (dev draw: 7e-15), Frobenius distance > 1, reproducible from its stream, own draw per context

hard_gates: exact writing (immediate inverse) and unwritten nodes at phi
matrices and frequencies unchanged, no global RNG, read-only batches
measurement errors per episode, time and node; shared between tasks on common nodes; every draw from its own role stream
batch-size and order independence of the simulation (<= 1e-13)
joint permutation of all node objects keeps the features (plan mutant 2 permutes only C and is detected)

dev_runtime.simulation: about 27 ms per episode and condition (RK4, 500 steps, chunk 256, this PC)
dev_runtime.full_volume_estimate: 2250 episodes x 4 conditions x 20 contexts ~ 80 min -- an estimate; the LR5 benchmark measures it (plan budget 2 h production)
